hints: Use the formula $d = \dfrac{|ax_0 + by_0 + c|}{\sqrt{a^2 + b^2}}$ for point $(3, 4)$ and line $3x + 4y - 5 = 0$.
walkthrough:
The shortest centre-to-line distance follows a perpendicular.
Substitute $(x_0, y_0) = (3, 4)$ and line $3x + 4y - 5 = 0$ into the perpendicular distance formula:
$$d = \dfrac{|3(3) + 4(4) - 5|}{\sqrt{3^2 + 4^2}}$$
